sidebar_encrypted: End-to-end encrypted: the server sees only ciphertext.
detail_not_found: There is no such entry here.
groups_intro: Groups share vaults with several people at once.
welcome_text: Create a new company or open the invitation link you received.
setup_code_hint: It is in the server's settings.
passphrase_hint: At least four words or 16 characters. Nobody can reset it.
kit_text: With the account ID, the Secret Key and your passphrase you unlock a new device; the Recovery Key gets you into your account if you forget the passphrase. Write them down or print them and keep them safe.
kit_saved: I have stored the recovery kit safely.
error_invalid_invitation: This invitation is no longer valid.
error_too_many: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes.
error_wrong_passphrase: Passphrase or Secret Key is wrong.
error_unexpected: That did not work. Try again.
kit_qr: Scan this code with a new device: it fills in server, account ID and Secret Key. You type the passphrase yourself; the Recovery Key is not in the code.
kit_keep: Keep this sheet safe, in a safe or with your documents. Whoever has it and knows your passphrase can get into your account. Nobody can reset your passphrase or Recovery Key for you.
error_wrong_recovery_key: The account ID or Recovery Key is wrong.
recover_text: The Recovery Key from your Recovery Kit gets you back into your account. Then you choose a new passphrase and get a new Recovery Kit; nobody can sign in with the old Recovery Key after that.
pair_text: Scan this code with the camera of a device where Kennwort is unlocked, or open Settings → Add device there and paste the link below.
pair_code_question: Does the other device show the same code?
pair_waiting: Waiting for the other device to confirm …
pair_failed: Connecting did not work. Start again.
add_text: On the new device, open “Connect with another device” and scan its code with the camera, or paste the link here.
add_code_question: Does the new device show the same code? Only then add it.
add_error_link: This is not a link to connect.
add_error_gone: This connection no longer exists. Start it again on the new device.
add_error_key: The server delivered a different key than the code shows. The device was not added.
devices_load_failed: The devices could not be loaded.
devices_remove_failed: The device could not be signed out.
members_invite_hint: Valid for seven days and only once. Send it by a channel you trust.
members_confirm_mismatch: These keys do not belong to your invitation. Kennwort does not confirm them.
members_confirm_used: You already confirmed this invitation for another account.
members_root_mismatch: The company key from the server does not match your account. Kennwort therefore shows no members.
members_load_failed: The members could not be loaded.
members_confirm_other_keys: Your device knows other keys for this account. Kennwort does not confirm these.
